# NAMI Vermont

> NAMI Vermont (National Alliance on Mental Illness of Vermont) provides mental health education, peer and family support groups, advocacy, and recovery programs throughout Vermont.

The organization offers evidence-based programs including Family-to-Family education courses, Connection Recovery Support Groups, Mental Illness & Recovery workshops, and FaithNet presentations. NAMI Vermont partners with Vermont Care Partners and other stakeholders to advance mental health awareness and advocacy across the state.

## Key Topics

- Family-to-Family education program
- Mental Health Awareness Month
- Peer support groups
- Facilitator training
- Mental health advocacy
- Family support and education
- Connection Recovery Support Groups
- Mental Illness & Recovery workshops
- NAMI FaithNet
- Vermont Care Partners
- Community mental health support
- Volunteer training opportunities
- Mental health awareness campaigns
- Family Voices presentations

## Support Groups & Peer Programs

- [Support Groups](https://namivt.org/support-groups): Peer and family support groups with facilitator training info
- [Connection Support Group Facilitator Training Registration](https://namivt.org/connection-support-group-facilitator-training): Free training for Connection Recovery Support Group facilitators
- [NAMI Connections Peer Support Group Facilitator Training in Brattleboro](https://namivt.org/featured-news/nami-connections-peer-support-group-facilitator-training-in-brattleboro): Peer support facilitator training at Brattleboro Retreat

## Family Education & Support

- [Family-to-Family Fall 2025 Class](https://namivt.org/featured-news/family-to-family-fall-2025-class): Free 8-week virtual Family-to-Family class for families affected by MH
- [Education and Support for Families](https://namivt.org/featured-news/do-you-care-about-someone-with-a-mental-health-condition): Overview of NAMI Family-to-Family Education Program for caregivers
- [Family-to-Family in Rutland & St. Johnsbury](https://namivt.org/blog/family-to-family-in-rutland-st-johnsbury): Family-to-Family courses offered in Rutland and St. Johnsbury
- [Family Voices](https://namivt.org/family-voices): Family Voices presentation program building empathy through lived experience

## Workshops & Recovery Programs

- [NAMI Vermont Offers "Mental Illness & Recovery" Workshop](https://namivt.org/featured-news/nami-vermont-offers-mental-illness-recovery-workshop): Mental Illness & Recovery workshop offered in Newport and statewide
- [Spring Mental Illness & Recovery Workshop Dates](https://namivt.org/events/spring-mental-illness-recovery-workshop-dates): Spring 2023 workshops in Essex Junction and Brattleboro
- [FaithNet Evaluation](https://namivt.org/faithnet-evaluation): Feedback form for NAMI FaithNet presentation attendees

## Get Involved & Support NAMI Vermont

- [Ways to Give](https://namivt.org/get-involved/ways-to-give): Donation options including recurring gifts and memorial contributions
- [Vote for NAMI Vermont for the 2023 IMPACT Awards](https://namivt.org/blog/vote-for-nami-vermont-for-the-2023-impact-awards): NAMI Vermont seeks votes for Red Sox Foundation IMPACT Awards by May 31

## Mental Health Advocacy & Awareness

- [Mental Health Advocacy Day - Feb. 1 @ 10:00 am virtually by zoom](https://namivt.org/blog/mental-health-advocacy-day-feb-1-1030-am-virtually-by-zoom): Virtual advocacy event with Vermont Care Partners and stakeholders
- [Mental Health Advocacy Day This Wednesday!](https://namivt.org/blog/mental-health-advocacy-day-this-wednesday): Announcement for State House advocacy day with coalition partners
- [Vermont Mental Health Awareness Month](https://namivt.org/featured-news/mental-health-awareness-month-vermont): Vermont officially recognizes May as Mental Health Awareness Month
- [May is Mental Health Awareness Month](https://namivt.org/blog/may-is-mental-health-awareness-month-3): Mental Health Awareness Month activities including Pathways conference
- [Join our Mental Health Awareness Month Project!](https://namivt.org/blog/join-our-mental-health-awareness-month-project): Community video/photo project for Mental Health Awareness Month
